verdict.rationale: monday.com advertises 850+ integrations, 2-way sync with "any platform," no-code connections to thousands of tools, and a GraphQL API and SDKs, so updating status from an external tool is plausible. The named integration categories cover sales, dev (GitHub/GitLab), communication and support, but none is a design tool. Missing for 10: any named design-tool integration (e.g., Figma), documentation of updating item status from inside a design app, hands-on or independent corroboration.
